title: Software & Systems Engineering

seo.title: Software & Systems Engineering | Julie Zimmerman
seo.description: Software and systems engineering focused on reliability, automation, maintainability, and complex problem solving.

hero.headline: Turning complicated operational problems into understandable systems.
intro: I work across the full stack, from C, Perl, Java, and Oracle enterprise software to modern PHP, JavaScript, Python tooling, APIs, and static publishing systems.
The consistent thread is systems thinking: identifying boundaries, assumptions, failure modes, and the smallest architecture that can remain reliable over time.

philosophy.title: Engineering Philosophy
philosophy.anchor: Good engineering makes complexity legible before it tries to automate it.
philosophy.intro: Understand the whole system before optimizing one component.
principles: Make assumptions explicit and failure states observable.
Prefer simple, inspectable architectures over unnecessary machinery.
Automation should remove repetition without removing human understanding.
philosophy.closing: Automation should remove repetition without removing human understanding.

problems.title: Problems I Solve
problems.intro: The most valuable work usually begins where a system has accumulated complexity, operational risk, or assumptions no one has revisited.
items: Cross-disciplinary architecture spanning software, data, security, and operations

approach.title: How I Work
paragraphs: I decompose systems by responsibility, state, data flow, and failure behavior. That exposes where complexity is essential and where it is accidental.
I then build in small, verifiable layers, preserving working behavior while reducing ambiguity and operational burden.

experience.summary: Lead developer and systems architect for a large, long-lived portfolio of production websites and integrations.
evidence: Technical standards, migration planning, launch QA, and incident response

experience.summary: Technical lead in enterprise higher-education software, working across large Oracle systems, performance testing, defect analysis, and release delivery.
evidence: Synthetic data generation exceeding one million records

related_writing.title: Related Writing
related_writing.intro: Case studies and essays that show the underlying engineering decisions.

business_value.title: Why systems thinking matters
paragraphs: Organizations rarely suffer from a lack of tools. They suffer from unclear boundaries, duplicated responsibility, invisible assumptions, and systems that no longer match the work.
Systems engineering creates leverage by correcting those structural problems instead of adding another layer on top of them.

contact.title: Let's Talk
paragraphs: For technical leadership, architecture, modernization, or complex systems work, contact me directly.

closing_statement: The right solution is usually the one that makes the system easier to reason about.
